neet_che_u02_t03_1.working: Davisson–Germer electron diffraction showed electrons diffracting like waves. The photoelectric effect and black-body radiation show particle nature. Line spectra show quantised energy levels.

neet_che_u02_t03_3.working: λ = h/√(2mK). At equal K, λ ∝ 1/√m, so λp/λα = √(mα/mp) = √4 = 2. Ratio is 2:1.

neet_che_u02_t03_4.working: A: λ = h/mv uses momentum, so III. B: 2πr = nλ is the stable-orbit condition giving mvr = nh/2π, so I. C: 12.27/√V is for an electron accelerated through V, so II. D: h/√(2mKE) uses kinetic energy, so IV.

neet_che_u02_t03_5.working: A false: the proton is heavier, so at the same velocity its λ is shorter. B true: the electron microscope uses electron waves. C true: 2πr = nλ with n = 3. D true: large mass gives negligible λ. E false: λ is inversely proportional to momentum. Correct statements are B, C and D.
